Instagram Caption Templates

40+ categorized Instagram caption templates with fill-in-the-blank fields.

Your caption

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a caption category.
  2. Choose a template from the list.
  3. Fill in each [blank] with your own words.
  4. Click Fill, then Copy Caption.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I use a template?

Pick a category, choose a template, fill in the [blanks], and click Fill to get your finished caption.

What categories are included?

Motivational, funny, travel, food, selfies, business, love, fitness, and more — over 40 templates total.

What do the [brackets] mean?

Square brackets [like this] mark the blanks. Type your words into the field for each blank.

How do I copy the result?

Click Copy Caption to copy the finished caption with hashtags, ready to paste into Instagram.
